response.sql: SELECT film.language_id, AVG(film.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(film.length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE film.length > 112 GROUP BY film.language_id ORDER BY (avg_length IS NULL), avg_length DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only languages that appear in the filtered film table (with length > 112) are included; languages with no such films do not appear in the result.
